Which statement explains why graphite can be used as a lubricant?
A
All of the atoms in graphite are carbon.
B
Each carbon atom forms three bonds.
C
Graphite has a macromolecular structure.
D
The layers in graphite can slide over each other.

options.label: A
options.text: All of the atoms in graphite are carbon.

options.label: B
options.text: Each carbon atom forms three bonds.

options.label: D
options.text: The layers in graphite can slide over each other.
